leaves.basis: Real ReplyTransport and LocalFuture own the same typed messages, response statuses, per-rank FIFO and credits. Pipe scheduling and capacity are convenient substitutes; this does not prove shared-memory backpressure or production timing.
leaves.leaf: Four spawned OS-process Pipe endpoints and bounded pickle FIFO
leaves.replaces: MultiprocExecutor shared-memory broadcast and response queues

leaves.basis: A receiver event completes only after the matching sender's transaction, stage and sequence are published across processes. It does not prove NCCL progress or CUDA ordering.
leaves.leaf: Process-shared PP identity slots and queried CPU events
leaves.replaces: PrefillPPChannel NCCL send/receive and CUDA prefill-stream events

leaves.basis: Actual QsaLayerDriver, QsaPrefillOperation, LaneDispatcher and NativeWorkerBridge execute over a reduced model. Numerical kernels and TP collectives are not represented.
leaves.leaf: Synthetic CPU QSA tensors, operations and four-layer model
leaves.replaces: Production 48-layer TP2PP2 model and device kernels

leaves.basis: The pinned stock config, KV layout resolution, scheduler config generation, AsyncScheduler, Request and allocator run as real classes; cache-owner geometry is a CPU projection.
Proves request and allocator progress after native closure through the real scheduler. It cannot prove decoded token values or model output.
leaves.leaf: Synthetic ModelRunnerOutput with fixed sampled token
leaves.replaces: Production model sampling for the following scheduler request

leaves.basis: Only the declared endpoint timing changes. Actual driver deadlines, transport ownership and cancellation logic stay unpatched.
leaves.leaf: One selected worker reply delay or missing reply
leaves.replaces: Worker RPC latency, scheduling pause or transport loss

leaves.basis: The actual driver's absolute-deadline check and named refusal execute while process RPCs retain enough wall-clock reply time. The earlier 0.3-second transport deadline expired inside ReplyTransport before the profile refusal; that development failure was a HARNESS timing leaf, not a completed engine-profile proof.
leaves.leaf: Injectable monotonic clock advanced after three real pending profile polls
leaves.replaces: Elapsed wall time at the 300-second production profile deadline

leaves.basis: A separate real Python thread calls the unchanged executor hook while the actual ReplyTransport has a submitted profile RPC. The thread identity and MQ owner retention are observed; stock EngineCore monitor orchestration is not constructed.
leaves.leaf: Named monitor-thread close during one outstanding profile RPC
leaves.replaces: Stock worker-monitor/IO thread that invokes before_shutdown after a failed engine tick

leaves.basis: The process endpoint executes the profile poll but drops its reply. The actual ReplyTransport deadline and poisoned close path execute. The Pipe leaf cannot prove shared-memory receiver progress.
leaves.leaf: One worker omits its typed profile RPC reply

leaves.basis: The actual AsyncScheduler, Request preprocessing, hybrid KVCacheManager, block pool and PrefillAdmissionController allocate, publish, lookup and reserve the same block objects. Synthetic sampled tokens do not prove model numerics.
leaves.leaf: CPU model outputs populate a 4048-row hybrid prefix page
leaves.replaces: ModelRunnerOutput tokens and cache block publication from a completed production request

leaves.basis: The case tests real stock prefix deferral and subsequent native commit, not selection timing. The actual worker QSA profile is still queried and the real dispatcher/bridge/driver retire the holder; CUDA timing is deferred to the VM and box gates.
leaves.leaf: Ready-on-first-query CPU selection event in the cached-prefix scenario
leaves.replaces: Device selection-copy event timing while native holder commits

leaves.basis: The actual worker report and driver journal must contain a losslessly paged vector longer than 64; a second native admission must commit after cancel. CPU events and selected rows are explicit convenient leaves.
leaves.leaf: Reduced 65-wave sparse selection and client disconnect at report poll
leaves.replaces: Production selection history and client transport disconnect during a paged worker report

scope_note: Twelve connected CPU scenarios re-run on native21 source. CUDA thread-local ownership is exercised separately by native21_rpc_stream_fixture_leaves.json and the one-card VM proof; these coordinator leaves are not box evidence.
